name: Availability Heuristic
definition: Ease of recalling examples substitutes for evidence about frequency or probability.
boundary: Recency can make examples accessible, but the diagnostic mechanism is recall-based likelihood judgment.

source_variants.name: Availability Heuristic (Erişilebilirlik kestirimi)
source_variants.definition: Treating vivid, recent or often-repeated examples as more common than the evidence supports.
source_variants.coverage_reason: No named mechanism, required state or observation model is implemented in the original Mesa sample.
